rationale: Floor runs (7.02 ns, 0.4 margins, cap213) at util 41-45 all reach T_eff 6.33-6.34, setup-limited at ss 100C max-RC by an I/O-port path (+0.68-0.69 ns); hold +0.09 ns, no hold buffers, 0 slew/cap pins vs 309, DRC clears. The optimizer's util picks 32, 38 and 48 all regressed (reg-to-reg +0.54, port +0.50), so pin util 42, between the best port slack (41) and best reg-to-reg (43, sizing off, +0.87). Reg-to-reg headroom matters when the best run is re-run at tighter clocks, where scaled I/O delays ease the port path, so keep sizing off, plus post-GRT timing repair, timing-driven placement, cap213 and the 0.4 post-GRT margin. Free the placement margin; post-GRT repair still targets 0.4.
